description: Electric Vehicle Charging Points is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This dataset provides data surrounding t he number of EV charging points that exist in Leicester City. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Environment and Energy, Transport. Its keywords are environment, CO2, NO2, Transport, traffic. The portal shows 230 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2022-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
